shared_elements: rosette or radiating floral motif (rosette band in B, flower heads in A)
fine linear incised detailing (feather/hatching in A, patterned bands in B)
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organised into horizontal registers with a border band of repeated rosette/floral units and dense fine incised linear detail, which is a real but fairly generic shared convention. What is depicted differs almost entirely: A shows a bird-headed winged anthropomorphic figure striding beside a stylized flowering tree with a text band above, while B shows a large multi-spoked chariot wheel with horses and patterned textile, sharing no figure, creature or object type.
